summary: Plaintiffs first raised fees in the opening proposal, and fees were negotiated together with class relief before the final settlement was reached. The transcript links fees to relief through all-in bargaining and provisions directing unawarded fees to the class. Class counsel considered its own fee compensation, but the transcript does not clearly show counsel sacrificing class relief for firm fees or a misleading declaration. Defense settled with Hargrove in a way that would release overlapping claims, amid competing counsel dynamics.
